1_trainee.notes: Complete the intro job to advance to Rookie.

2_rookie.strategy: Stack Baijini → Riker contracts for fastest progression.

3_junior.contracts_available: small and medium cargo, max 8 SCU containers
3_junior.strategy: Add medium contracts on same Baijini → Riker route.

4_member.contracts_available: broader route pool, higher-tier medium contracts, Everus Harbor unlocks
4_member.strategy: Hull-B becomes viable here. Focus on same-pickup stacking.

5_experienced.contracts_available: large hauls begin, increased medium limits
5_experienced.strategy: 10-mission stacking at Everus Harbor. About 26 Experienced missions to reach Senior.
5_experienced.notes: Member → Experienced: use Everus Harbor route with 10-mission stacks.

6_senior.contracts_available: bulk rate hauls, Lagrange delivery stacking
6_senior.strategy: Hull-C required for bulk rate contracts. Use ATLS exosuit for freight handling. About 40 Senior missions to reach Master.
6_senior.notes: Lagrange delivery stacking and partial-submit strategies optimal here.

7_master.strategy: Stack Lagrange deliveries, submit efficient partials.
